label: Who We Are paragraph
text: ARISE CHURCH is designed to change the lives of men, women, and children as they journey towards their own personal greatness within God’s ordained purpose. Arise Church has the mandate to teach people who they are in Christ and how they should function as effective kingdom citizens on earth. The various ministries and outreaches at ARISE CHURCH are aimed to serve both the body of Christ and central Louisiana. We aspire to train ambassadors for Christ who model the glory of God in their lives, while revealing His kingdom on earth.

label: Mission paragraph 1
text: Our mission for this year is to Impact Tioga—to bring the life-changing love of Jesus Christ into every corner of our community, transforming lives, families, and the town we call home.
where: Black Mission section, paragraph 1

label: Mission paragraph 2
text: We are called to help Tioga discover Christ: to share the Gospel boldly and compassionately, inviting every person to encounter the Savior who redeems, restores, and gives eternal hope.
where: Black Mission section, paragraph 2

label: Mission paragraph 3
text: We are committed to building the community together: partnering with neighbors, schools, businesses, and local leaders to foster unity, serve those in need, and create spaces where everyone feels seen, valued, and loved.
where: Black Mission section, paragraph 3

label: Mission paragraph 4
text: We are devoted to supporting one another: walking alongside each other in prayer, encouragement, and practical help, strengthening families, lifting up the hurting, and growing together as the family of God.
where: Black Mission section, paragraph 4

label: Mission paragraph 5
text: This is our moment. With God’s uncommon favor upon us, we will rise up as one church, one body, to make a lasting impact—for the glory of Jesus and the good of Tioga.
where: Black Mission section, paragraph 5
